meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装好后，用户要求修复 bug 时，Claude 会在临时工作区复现并诊断问题，然后按归属交付：属于 LazyCodex 的以含补丁的 issue 形式提供，属于上游 Codex CLI 的以 fork PR 形式提供，并附修复前后测试证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、提交 bug 修复，或调试并给 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷提交 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 在 Windows 上崩溃的问题并提交修复。
为 Codex CLI 的这个报错修一下，并开一个 PR。
say.note: 从 fork 创建 PR，含复现与验证日志。

say.text: 调试一下 omo-codex 的打包问题，给出最小修复。
say.note: 生成含补丁的 issue 并附测试证据。

howto.what_en: On a bug-fix request, Claude reproduces the defect in a temp workspace, then delivers either a verified-fix issue with an embedded patch (for LazyCodex) or a fork PR (for upstream Codex CLI), including logs and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix the LazyCodex crash on Windows and submit the fix.
say_en.note: It will reproduce and create a verified-fix issue.

say_en.text: Fix this Codex CLI error and open a PR for it.
say_en.note: Creates a fork PR with repro and verification logs.

say_en.text: Debug the omo-codex packaging issue and give the smallest fix.
say_en.note: Delivers an issue with an embedded patch and evidence.
